title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.

In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants. Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written proficiency with English.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

Indicadores (KPIs)

  • Aderência ao cronograma por obra e consolidado (variação % físico / curva).

  • Não conformidades e retrabalho por etapa/empreiteiro (taxa e reincidência).
  • Taxa de incidentes / horas trabalhadas e aderência a ritos de SST.
  • Produtividade por frente/empreiteiro (tendência vs referência).
  • Previsibilidade : % de obras sem “surpresas” relevantes no mês (prazos/custos).

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia Civil (concluída) e CREA ativo.
  • Experiência prévia como Engenheiro Residente/Coordenador de Obra em edificações verticais e/ou paredes de concreto, com vivência relevante em gestão de múltiplas frentes e empreiteiros.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com Lean Construction/Last Planner (PPC), BIM/compatibilização, paredes de concreto e sistemas industrializados.
  • Experiência com ERP/Sienge (ou similar), gestão de contratos e curvas S físico-financeiras.
  • Histórico de melhoria de performance via padronização de método, gestão por indicadores e desenvolvimento de time.

Perfil comportamental

  • Liderança exigente e desenvolvedora: cobra padrão e faz o time evoluir.
  • Visão sistêmica + profundidade técnica: enxerga o portfólio sem perder a qualidade da decisão.
  • Disciplina de gestão: ritos, indicadores e registros consistentes.
  • Postura de dono e prevenção: antecipa riscos e atua antes do desvio virar crise.
  • Comunicação objetiva: alinhamento claro com obra, suporte e diretoria.

Remuneração e benefícios

  • Remuneração fixa compatível com o mercado e senioridade.
  • Ganhos variáveis vinculados a metas do portfólio (prazo/custo/qualidade/SST).

i4pro + você = i4evc

title: Lead Training Consultant - SAP IBP & ePPDS
description:
About Company::

Bristlecone is a supply chain and business analytics advisor, serving customers across a wide range of industries. Rated by Gartner as among the top ten system integrators in the supply chain space, we are uniquely positioned to solve contemporary business problems, with supply chain and analytics focus as our advantage. We have been a trusted partner and advisor to many leading, globally recognized companies such as Applied Materials, Exxon Mobil, Flextronics, LSI Logic, Mahindra, Motorola, Nestle, Palm, Qatar Petroleum, Ranbaxy, Unilever and Whirlpool and many others.

Role Overview:

Language Required- Spanish Speaking

Should be open to travel to Mexico on needed basis

Role Objective

The Lead Training Consultant will be responsible for the end-to-end educational lifecycle of our digital supply chain transformation. This role requires a unique individual who can not only configure SAP IBP and ePPDS modules but also translate complex technical processes into comprehensive training programs for diverse business audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Training Strategy: Conduct comprehensive Training Needs Analysis (TNA) to identify skill gaps and design a global curriculum covering SAP IBP (Demand, S&OP, Response & Supply) and ePPDS.
  • Content Development: Create high-quality, multi-format training materials including Instructor-Led Training (ILT) decks, Quick Reference Guides (QRGs), video tutorials, and interactive eLearning modules.
  • Hands-on Facilitation: Deliver engaging training sessions to Super Users and End Users, utilizing real-world business scenarios in a dedicated training environment.
  • Environment Management: Manage and maintain the SAP training landscape (Sandbox), ensuring master data is refreshed and aligned for practical hands-on labs.
  • Post-Go-Live Support: Provide critical Hypercare support and refresher training post-deployment to ensure high system adoption and user proficiency.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Technical Mastery: Deep functional knowledge of SAP IBP (specifically Order-Based Planning ) and ePPDS (embedded Production Planning & Detailed Scheduling) in S/4HANA.
  • Training Expertise: Proven experience in end-to-end training delivery for large-scale SAP implementations, from curriculum design to final assessment.

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non-technical users.

title: Concierge Médico - Clinica de Alto Padrão
description:
Você é apaixonado(a) por atendimento, cuidado com o próximo e excelência em encantar pessoas? Estamos em busca de um(a) Concierge Médico(a) para integrar nosso time e proporcionar uma jornada única aos nossos pacientes!

Sobre a Vaga:

No Instituto Roar, o(a) Concierge é muito mais do que um recepcionista – é o primeiro e o último contato com o paciente. É quem acolhe, orienta, acompanha, cuida dos detalhes e garante que cada pessoa tenha uma experiência memorável e personalizada do início ao fim do tratamento.

Responsabilidades:

• Receber e acolher pacientes de forma humanizada e empática.

• Acompanhar o paciente antes, durante e após consultas e procedimentos.

• Garantir o cumprimento da jornada do paciente, conforme protocolos da clínica.

• Realizar envio de receitas, orientações e materiais pós-consulta.

• Cuidar da experiência do paciente com excelência e atenção aos detalhes.

• Realizar ações de encantamento (parabéns de aniversário, vouchers de retorno, lembretes, brindes).

• Coordenar reagendamentos, retornos e direcionamentos para equipe médica e nutricional.

• Apoiar o time clínico e comercial com informações precisas sobre os atendimentos.

• Garantir que todos os dados do paciente estejam registrados corretamente nos sistemas da clínica.

Pré-Requisitos:

• Ensino médio completo (Superior em áreas da saúde, hospitalidade ou estética é um diferencial).

• Experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente (preferencialmente em clínicas médicas/estéticas).

• Excelência em comunicação, postura e empatia.

• Organização, proatividade e atenção aos detalhes.

• Domínio de ferramentas básicas (agenda digital, WhatsApp, sistemas de prontuário eletrônico, CRM).

Diferenciais:

• Experiência com customer success, hospitalidade de luxo ou estética premium.

• Conhecimento prévio do sistema Kommo, MedX ou plataformas similares.

• Vontade de crescer em um ambiente moderno, com propósito e foco em excelência.

⸻

Regime de contratação:

• PJ + Vale-Transporte + Comissionamento por vendas

• Bonificações por desempenho e metas

• Treinamento contínuo e plano de crescimento

Local de trabalho:

Instituto Roar – Brooklin, São Paulo – SP

Horário: Segunda a sabado

⸻

Se você acredita que pode entregar mais do que um atendimento – e sim, uma experiência transformadora para nossos pacientes – envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte do Instituto Roar!

title: Legal Operations Engineer | Desenvolvimento de Sistemas Jurídicos
description:
Descrição da vaga Legal Operations Engineer | Desenvolvimento de Sistemas Jurídicos

Não somos um escritório de advocacia convencional.

Somos para aqueles que buscam o novo, que desenvolvem produtos e serviços inovadores ou que procuram mudar os conceitos tradicionais com uma visão moderna, objetiva e criativa. Ou, ainda, para aqueles que acreditam que a própria advocacia pode ser modernizada para melhor atender às necessidades do mundo atual.

Estamos buscando profissionais de Legal Operations com perfil técnico para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento de soluções jurídicas.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Você trabalhará na criação e implementação de sistemas jurídicos escaláveis, combinando sua experiência em operações jurídicas com ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento. Oferecemos treinamento completo em nossa plataforma, que permite transformar conhecimento jurídico em aplicações funcionais.

Responsabilidades

* Disposição para aprender, desenvolver e implementar sistemas jurídicos

* Mapear, desenhar e otimizar fluxos e processos internos de departamentos jurídicos

* Criar automações e soluções que aumentem eficiência, segurança e qualidade operacional

* Colaborar com equipes jurídicas para entender necessidades e traduzir em requisitos técnicos

* Estruturar bases de dados e modelar informações jurídicas

Requisitos Essenciais

* Formação em Direito com experiência comprovada em Legal Operations

* Excel avançado (fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas, Power Query)

* Experiência em mapeamento e otimização de processos

* Forte capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes

* Mentalidade orientada a soluções e melhoria contínua

Diferenciais Importantes

* Conhecimento em bancos de dados SQL

* Experiência com programação (qualquer linguagem)

* Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA e automação

* Experiência com ferramentas no-code/low-code

* Conhecimento em APIs e integrações de sistemas

O que Oferecemos

* Treinamento completo em nossa plataforma proprietária

* Oportunidade de trabalhar na intersecção entre Direito e Tecnologia

* Ambiente inovador focado em transformação digital jurídica

Perfil Ideal

Buscamos profissionais curiosos, com paixão por tecnologia e capacidade de pensar sistemicamente. Você deve se sentir confortável aprendendo novas ferramentas e traduzindo necessidades jurídicas complexas em soluções tecnológicas práticas.

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior | Controladoria
description:
A helloo desenvolve e opera soluções de mídia digital out of home em diferentes ambientes, como elevadores residenciais, shopping centers e aeroportos. Sua atuação abrange mais de 16 mil elevadores em condomínios , mais de 100 shoppings no Brasil e 17 aeroportos sob concessão da Aena, incluindo o de Congonhas, em São Paulo, por meio de uma parceria com a empresa NEOOH.

A empresa atende tanto grandes anunciantes quanto pequenos e médios empreendedores, utilizando dados comportamentais obtidos em seus pontos de presença para segmentar campanhas com maior precisão. Além disso, a helloo mantém uma operação dedicada à criação de experiências interativas em elevadores e espaços comerciais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

title: Talent and Learning Specialist
description:
The Talent and Learning Specialist is responsible for supporting the execution of the regional Talent strategy in Latin America (includes but not limited to: Mexico, Chile, Brazil, Colombia, and Trinidad & Tobago) and supporting the regional Learning strategy across the Americas that will enable business growth by focusing on our most important asset, our people.

The specialist in this role will support the design and execution of key global and regional strategic talent and learning initiatives and resources to promote critical organizational and professional growth. This person will have an opportunity to connect with stakeholders from multiple LATAM countries, identify local needs, drive regional talent efforts in LATAM, and ensure learning programs and opportunities are designed with the regional lens and delivered effectively.

We are looking for a hands-on, inclusive and collaborative team player, who is passionate about people development and implementing regional and global programs.

Regional Talent Strategy and Execution

  • Conduct gap analyses and competency mapping to identify regional training needs (e.g., commercial and sales)

  • Support Brazil-specific programs (U.Supervise Field/Office, Finance for Non-Finance, and future offerings )in partnership with local HR Partners and operations managers

Stakeholder Engagement and Support

  • Engage with LATAM stakeholders (i.e., LATAM Director, country managers, group leaders, HR Partners, etc.) to support talent initiatives, resources, timelines, and offerings
  • Partner with LATAM Director on talent initiatives (e.g., engagement survey data analysis, employee development, Talent Review, etc.)

Culture and Engagement

  • Manage and expand, as needed, LATAM Welcome Day for new hires, partnering and supporting HR Partners as needed; maintain close communication with regional talent team to drive consistency and program changes
  • Partner with HR Partners on interpreting Peakon Engagement Survey data and supporting action plans

Communications and Operations Support

  • Lead LATAM communication campaigns to promote our people processes and various other talent fronts

Required

Preferred

At Fugro, you’ll be part of a global team committed to innovation, sustainability, and creating a safe and liveable world. We offer opportunities to make a real impact, grow your career, and work on meaningful projects that shape the future.

This position requires a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to interact with multiple areas in a dynamic and deadline-driven environment.

Role Purpose

The Accounting Specialist supports group reporting activities and intercompany reconciliation processes, contributing to monthly cost closing, variance analysis, and the maintenance of a strong internal control environment. The role ensures compliance with accounting policies while providing reliable financial insights to support business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Group Reporting

  • Prepare and submit group reporting packages in line with corporate deadlines.
  • Analyze and explain balance variations versus prior periods.
  • Support group-level requests with accurate and well-documented information.

Há mais de 20 anos, o Grupo MAST é referência nacional em Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho , sendo um ecossistema completo de saúde do trabalhador .

Na prática, este papel atua como dono do processo dentro do sistema: parametriza, integra, monitora, audita, treina usuários e transforma necessidades do negócio em execução consistente dentro do SOC, com foco em escala, redução de retrabalho e controle de risco (operacional e regulatório).

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada com a plataforma SOC em operação real (administração funcional, parametrização, sustentação e melhoria de processos).
  • Ciência de desenho e governança de processos (BPM), com mapeamento AS-IS/TO-BE, definição de controles, padronização, indicadores e rotinas de auditoria.
  • Vivência consistente com eSocial SST, com entendimento de cadastros críticos, dependências de dados, leitura e saneamento de inconsistências, acompanhamento de retornos e rastreabilidade.
  • Capacidade de conduzir testes funcionais (UAT), elaborar critérios de aceite, planejar rollout e assegurar estabilidade de mudanças em ambiente produtivo.
  • Experiência com integrações de dados (como analista funcional ou em parceria com TI) para especificação de requisitos, mapeamento de campos, validações, conciliação de cargas e troubleshooting de falhas.
  • Forte domínio de Excel/Google Sheets para análise operacional (tabelas dinâmicas, cruzamentos, validações, auditoria de cadastros e controles).
  • Desejável familiaridade com SQL e/ou ferramentas de BI para auditoria e monitoramento de indicadores.
  • Conhecimento prático de LGPD e boas práticas de segurança da informação aplicadas a dados de saúde (controle de acesso, minimização de dados, rastreabilidade e governança). Soft Skills
  • Mentalidade de dono, com foco em padronização, estabilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Raciocínio analítico e orientação a causa raiz, com capacidade de transformar sintomas operacionais em correções estruturais.
  • Atenção a detalhes e rigor de qualidade: habilidade para manter consistência de dados e prevenir efeito cascata em rotinas críticas.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva com múltiplos públicos (Cliente, Operação, Segurança, RH, TI, fornecedores), traduzindo necessidades em regras e processos executáveis no sistema.
  • Didática e capacidade de treinamento: produzir material, conduzir capacitações e formar multiplicadores.
  • Organização e priorização: gestão de backlog, negociação de prazos/escopo e execução com previsibilidade.
  • Postura colaborativa e influência sem autoridade formal, alinhando áreas e sustentando governança.
  • Resiliência e disciplina operacional para lidar com alto volume e demandas simultâneas com qualidade. Diferenciais

  • Experiência em implantação, reestruturação ou virada de chave de operação (padronização de cadastros, revisão de processos, redução de retrabalho e melhoria de indicadores).
  • Vivência em rotinas avançadas de integrações com RH/Folha/ERP (inclusive reconciliação automática, monitoramento e tratamento proativo de falhas).

Requisitos:

  • Formação em SOC exemplo: Formação Superior SOC, SOC Analyst Fundamentals e correlatos

Aqui, acreditamos que pessoas saudáveis constroem empresas fortes .

Por isso, trabalhamos todos os dias com ética, transparência e inovação , unindo tecnologia e cuidado humano em tudo o que fazemos.

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As a Collections Specialist, your mission is to execute recoveries hands-on while building the foundations of a scalable, fair, and data-driven collections function.

You will work directly on active cases — negotiating, prioritizing, escalating, and resolving — while also turning what you learn into clear playbooks, policies, and operating processes.

This role sits at the intersection of execution and design:

  • You recover capital today
  • You help ensure we recover it better, faster, and more predictably tomorrow

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in collections in Brazil .
  • Fluent in Portuguese and basic English.
  • Solid understanding of legal and judicial recovery frameworks .
  • Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and cohorts .
  • Ability to reason about effort vs. yield economics .
  • Working knowledge of SQL / BI tools (hands-on or close collaboration).
  • Highly execution-oriented — comfortable being in the weeds.
  • Structured thinker who turns chaos into process.
  • Clear, practical communicator with Ops, Risk, and Legal.
  • Ownership mindset — sees gaps and fills them.

Responsibilities

  • Execute collections hands-on across delinquency stages and products.
  • Manage negotiations and recoveries , including complex or sensitive cases.
  • Help design and maintain collections playbooks and policies .
  • Continuously improve case prioritization and escalation logic .
  • Partner with Data to translate execution insights into better segmentation and models.
  • Support and monitor external partners (law firms, agencies).
  • Track and communicate recovery performance and operational insights.
  • Act as a builder of the collections function , not just an operator.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)

Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.

What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems

Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark

title: Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP)
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A ContabilizaEcom é uma empresa de contabilidade especialmente voltada para o e‑commerce, que combina expertise fiscal, tributária e empresarial para apoiar lojas online no Brasil.

Alguns destaques da empresa:

  • Foi criada por quem “nasceu em um e‑commerce”, ou seja, compreende os desafios práticos desse tipo de negócio.
  • Oferece serviços como abertura de empresa, análise fiscal de produtos, configuração de ERP e canais de venda, recuperação de impostos pagos indevidamente, planejamento tributário e busca de benefícios fiscais.
  • Foca em economia de impostos, segurança jurídica e regularização fiscal dos seus clientes.
  • Tem métricas que demonstram credibilidade: mais de 300 sellers ativos, cerca de 96% de satisfação dos clientes e mais de R$ 10 milhões em impostos economizados.

Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos procurando um Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP) para se juntar à equipe da ContabilizaEcom em Curitiba. Este cargo envolve a execução de tarefas diárias relacionadas a folha de pagamento no setor de departamento pessoal que busque a garantia de conformidade com as leis trabalhistas e legais vigentes.

Este é um cargo de tempo integral presencial, permitindo algumas atividades administrativas realizadas remotamente, onde o colaborador tem espaço para o crescimento em um ambiente descontraído com limites e responsabilidades.

Qualificações acadêmicas esperadas e atribuições da função

  • Formação: Graduação cursando ou completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Processamento da Folha: Executar o cálculo mensal da folha de pagamento, garantindo a exatidão de salários, descontos e proventos.
  • Cálculo de Encargos: Calcular e conferir o INSS, FGTS e IRRF.
  • Fechamento e Conferência: Realizar o fechamento da folha e emitir os relatórios de conferência (holerites), assegurando a conformidade legal.
  • Emissão de Guias: Gerar e enviar as guias de recolhimento dos encargos sociais e impostos (Ex: DAF, GPS/DARF Previdenciário).
  • Rotinas de Pessoal: executar cálculo e registro de férias e processamento de rescisões contratuais, com o devido registro no sistema.
  • Obrigações Acessórias: Realizar o lançamento e acompanhamento dos eventos mensais e periódicos no eSocial, garantindo a qualidade e o envio das informações.
  • Atendimento: Prestar suporte e esclarecimento de dúvidas aos colaboradores sobre holerites, benefícios e questões trabalhistas básicas.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Habilidades de análise.

description:

We are looking for a Cross Border Specialist to manage and optimize the performance of Third-Party Logistics (3PL) providers across South America . If you enjoy working with data, solving operational challenges, and collaborating with international partners in a fast-paced environment, this opportunity is for you!

What you’ll do:

  • Monitor and manage 3PL performance, ensuring compliance with SLAs
  • Track customs clearance deadlines and identify operational bottlenecks
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective action plans
  • Manage order delays, system failures, and tracking rule accuracy
  • Support last-mile operations and improve delivery performance
  • Analyze KPIs such as failure rates, delivery performance, and customer feedback
  • Collaborate with logistics partners to reduce return cycle times
  • Ensure proper closure of uncompleted shipments and claim settlements

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or related fields
  • At least 2 years of experience in 3PL management or supply chain operations
  • Experience with cross-border logistics is a strong plus
  • Solid understanding of customs clearance, last-mile delivery, and reverse logistics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset
  • Proficiency in Excel ; SQL and logistics systems are a plus
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • Spanish and Mandarin are a plus
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, international environment

Why join us?

  • Exposure to cross-border and international logistics operations
  • High-impact role with visibility across South America
  • Opportunity to work with multiple logistics partners and stakeholders
  • Fast-paced environment with room for growth and learning

Interested? Apply now or share with someone who might be a great fit!

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor de Busca)
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.

E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?

Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:

Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.

We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.

We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.

About the Project:

This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:

  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.

Requirements

  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.

Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Pessoas, Direito do Trabalho e Previdenciário, Gestão Empresarial, Finanças.

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Coordenador (a) de Manutenção Mecânica
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica ou Produção;

  • Conhecimento em sistema de gestão de manutenção SAP (PM);
  • Vivência em planejamento e controle da manutenção (PCM);
  • Experiência com gestão de equipes diretas e terceiras, incluindo análises de performance da equipe, avaliações de desempenho e feedbacks;

  • Conhecimento de indicadores de manutenção e ferramentas de melhoria contínua;
  • Noções de gestão de contratos e orçamentos;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente em Araucária/PR, de segunda a sexta em horário administrativo, mas com disponibilidade para gerir equipe que trabalha em turnos.

Serão considerados como diferenciais:

  • Certificações em TPM, RCM ou confiabilidade;
  • Especialização em Manutenção ou Gestão Industrial;
  • Experiência profissional em empresas com processos industriais contínuos e de batelada, e segmento químico.

Atividades:

  • Coordenar o time de manutenção e garantir o planejamento das atividades de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva, pelas equipes diretas e terceiras, nos equipamentos mecânicos assegurando as análises e diagnósticos das falhas;
  • Participar no desenvolvimento de planos de manutenção mecânica preventiva e preditiva, contribuindo e codificando sistemas, conjuntos mecânicos e componentes;

description:

  • Registrar e atualizar cotações e propostas no CRM e sistemas corporativos.
Pricing – Serviços de Exportação (China)
  • Desenvolver cotações de exportação a partir da China por modal marítimo, aéreo e multimodal.
  • Estruturar custos de coleta, consolidação, armazenagem, documentação e frete internacional.

Pricing – Serviços de Armazenagem Geral
  • Estruturar tabelas de preços de armazenagem por tipo de carga, metragem, peso e cubagem.
  • Precificar serviços de Armazém Geral com emissão de warrant e controle documental.
  • Definir custos de armazenagem fixa, variável e serviços agregados (movimentação, paletização, etiquetagem, inventário, cross-docking).

  • Integrar dados de WMS e custos operacionais na composição de preços.

  • Avaliar custos de risco, seguro, compliance e exigências regulatórias.
  • Revisar periodicamente margens e custos operacionais do armazém.

  • Elaborar cotações de transporte rodoviário fracionado e lotação em âmbito nacional.
  • Compor tarifas com base em km rodado, tipo de veículo, perfil de carga e nível de serviço.

  • Considerar pedágios, GRIS, seguro, gerenciamento de risco e taxas adicionais.
  • Construir tabelas de frete por rota, região e perfil de operação.
  • Desenvolver modelos de pricing para contratos recorrentes e operações spot.
  • Monitorar variações de combustível e impactos no custo de frete.
  • Apoiar decisões de contratação e homologação de fornecedores logísticos.
Responsabilidades Transversais (todas as frentes)
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas internas, compliance e diretrizes de governança.
  • Manter base de dados de tarifas e custos atualizada e auditável.

  • Desenvolver indicadores de performance de pricing e rentabilidade por serviço.
  • Participar de revisões periódicas de margem e estratégia tarifária.
  • Atuar com forte disciplina de registro sistêmico (CRM / ERP / planilhas controladas).
  • Propor melhorias contínuas nos modelos de precificação e inteligência de custos.

(Importação | Exportação | Armazém Geral | Transporte Rodoviário)

title: Senior Salesforce Business Analyst
description:
Job Title: Senior Salesforce Business Analyst

Duration: 6 months

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Need to support PST timings

Description:

Cohesity is seeking a Senior Salesforce Business Analyst to join our fast-growing Go-to Market Systems team. This person will be a high-level strategic contributor that understands and documents the internal customer’s business requirements. You will work with internal developers and create functional specifications that meet those requirements and test the developed functionality. As the primary business systems liaison to the Channel sales team, you will be responsible for designing, managing, and improving our Salesforce Community. Direct experience solutioning for Salesforce Communities. You will lead discovery and analysis sessions with stakeholders and help business teams derive unambiguous business rules and requirements that can be translated into actionable specifications for development teams.

  • Responsible for business requirement understanding, Writing JIRA User Stories, Sprint planning, backlog grooming, and working with the development team for planning and solutioning.
  • Work closely with other teams to understand current and future requirements; suggest solutions and alternatives - transform business processes through technology. This person will be hands-on and will need to be an expert in the Salesforce Community platform.
  • Facilitate design, implementation, maintenance and enhancement of the SFDC Community application as well as other declarative parts of the Salesforce platform.
  • Develop and configure Salesforce Gainsight solutions, including customer health scoring, success plans, journey orchestration, lifecycle management, and reporting to enable proactive customer success initiatives.
  • Implement AI-driven automation and intelligence using Salesforce Einstein, predictive case routing, sentiment analysis, intelligent recommendations, and automated workflows to improve service efficiency and customer experience.
  • Partner with business domain leaders to create a robust Enterprise Application roadmap. Ensure this roadmap is well understood throughout the business functions and meet emerging requirements. Take the abstract of this roadmap down to threads of executional framework.
  • Collaborate with other Business Systems Analyst and Product Managers in both the US and offshore locations to drive the work
  • Support existing Partner community solutions (and related applications), working on production support, trouble-shooting issues, and implementing small to large enhancements.
  • Deliver Salesforce platform updates as a key member responsible for the design, development and release of strategic projects.
  • Specify implementation of standards, methods, and procedures for inspecting, testing, and evaluating the precision and reliability of applications and software
  • Ensure Application Development initiatives and projects are well managed and deliver on expectations - functionality, timeliness, and cost
  • Able to foster a culture of transparency and a sense of purpose among the team, and create clear accountabilities and metrics

Professional Experience/Qualifications:

  • Has successfully led development and delivery of multiple complex business technology solutions into production that have achieved or surpassed business goals.
  • Experience developing and supporting mission critical applications optimized to run in the cloud or virtualized environments.
  • Deep knowledge of system architecture, technical design, and system and software
  • development technology.

Required Skills / Experiences:

  • 6+ years of IT experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Computer Engineering or equivalent technical degree
  • 3+ years of experience as a business analyst/product manager supporting Salesforce Community platform.
  • Deep understanding of the Salesforce.com product suite including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, FSL, Community Cloud, and the AppExchange.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Gainsight, including configuration, data modeling, rules engine, success plans, and reporting (or strong experience integrating Gainsight with Salesforce).
  • Knowledge of Customer Success metrics (Health Score, NPS, CSAT, Renewal Risk)
  • Experience implementing AI-powered automation within Salesforce using Einstein AI, predictive insights, and intelligent workflows.
  • Experience with Einstein Bots, Digital Engagement, and AI-driven service analytics
  • Managing application development at scale, employing SDLC methodologies including Agile, Scrum, and DevOps
  • Skilled at setting and communicating priorities effectively; able to manage multiple tasks and priorities
  • Exceptional ability to lead change using positive and collaborative methods
  • Strong communication skills in writing, speaking, and presenting
  • Able to communicate technical or complex subject matter in business terms
  • Accepts ownership and welcomes responsibility

title: Training Analyst
description:
GP Strategies Corporation is one of the world's leading talent transformation providers. By delivering award-winning learning and development solutions, we help organizations transform through their people and achieve meaningful change. GP Strategies has delivered our innovative consulting, learning services, and talent technology solutions to over 6,000 organizations globally.

Title: Training Analyst

Position: Full-time

Work Location: Hybrid ( 3/4 days in Brooklin Novo, Sao Paolo, Brazil )

Job Description

Project Analyst (Portuguese + English) | Hybrid (3/4 days at office in Sao Paolo, Brazil )

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail‑driven Project Administrator to support training operations and manage multiple senior client stakeholders with confidence and professionalism. This is a fully onsite role based in Brazil, requiring fluent Portuguese and functional English.

If you thrive in fast‑paced environments, enjoy coordinating complex learning activities, and excel at stakeholder communication, this opportunity is for you.

About the Role

As a Project Administrator, you will provide comprehensive administrative and system support to learners, facilitators, instructors, and third‑party partners. Your work ensures smooth, accurate, and timely delivery of training programs and learning experiences.

This role is central to the success of our learning operations and requires someone who is structured, resilient, and comfortable interacting with senior stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Training Coordination & Scheduling

  • Schedule classes and secure all required resources: instructors, facilitators, guest speakers, moderators, and facilities
  • Confirm bookings and ensure alignment with program requirements

LMS (Learning Management System) Administration

  • Load and update classes in the MetLife LMS
  • Manage changes to schedules, facilitators, and class capacities

Learning Materials & Logistics

  • Prepare and distribute physical and digital learning materials
  • Coordinate procurement, printing, and delivery of resources

Learner & Instructor Support

  • Send pre‑course communications and provide ongoing support
  • Serve as the primary point of contact during class delivery
  • Resolve real‑time issues by coordinating with relevant teams

Attendance & Certification Management

  • Generate rosters, track attendance, and update completions
  • Issue completion or failure certificates as required

Operational & Administrative Support

  • Validate invoices related to facilities or materials
  • Support Development Action Plan (DAP) activities
  • Manage user access, upload content, and maintain system data
  • Administer Qualtrics surveys and report satisfaction results
  • Extract Power BI reports and generate insights

Virtual & Onsite Training Support

  • Build session links and moderate Webex/Teams sessions
  • Prepare training rooms, materials, and logistics for in‑person sessions
  • Coordinate coffee breaks, shipping of materials, and IT requests
  • Arrive early to ensure room readiness and conduct technical checks
  • Store materials and close down the room after sessions

Post‑Session Activities

  • Save materials, photos, attendance lists, and survey data
  • Maintain organized digital records

Profile & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 2+ years of experience in learning operations, training coordination, or administrative support
  • Strong proficiency in Excel
  • Fluent Portuguese and functional English
  • Experience working with LMS platforms (preferred)

Skills & Competencies

  • Ability to generate data‑driven insights
  • Understanding of employee experience principles
  • Strong written communication skills
  • Highly structured, organized, and detail‑oriented
  • Creative problem‑solver
  • Resilient and adaptable in dynamic environments

If you’re ready to play a key role in delivering exceptional learning experiences and supporting high‑impact training programs, we’d love to connect with you.

title: Consultor funcional de Oracle AP
description:
A SOMMA IT está em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) Funcional Oracle Cloud AP para integrar nosso time em projetos desafiadores de implementação, rollout e sustentação.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar em projetos de Oracle Cloud , com foco nos módulos:
  • Accounts Payable (AP): parametrização do módulo, fluxos de aprovação (BPM), fluxo de pagamentos, retenções e integrações bancárias.
  • Fiscal Document Capture (FDC): configuração de regras fiscais, de/para de itens, captura e validação de documentos eletrônicos (NFe, NFSe).
  • Tax (Impostos): modelagem fiscal, retenções na fonte, regras tributárias e parametrização dos motores de cálculo de impostos.
  • Diferencial – Cash Management: parametrização, conciliação bancária, gestão de extratos e previsão de caixa.
  • Conduzir levantamento de requisitos (As Is), preparação de workshops (To Be), configuração do sistema e elaboração de documentos funcionais.
  • Apoiar o cliente em testes, homologações e sustentação (AMS).
  • Atuar como elo entre o time técnico e as áreas de negócio do cliente.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como consultor(a) funcional em Oracle Cloud (AP, FDC e Tax).
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos financeiros, fiscais e de tesouraria no cenário brasileiro.
  • Vivência com integrações fiscais (motores fiscais, SEFAZ, bancos, VAN bancárias).
  • Capacidade de análise crítica, visão de processo e foco em entrega de valor.
  • Desejável: inglês intermediário, experiência em consultorias, atuação em projetos remotos e presenciais.

Se você busca atuar em projetos estratégicos e ter a oportunidade de crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador, vem para a SOMMA IT !
